answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 32846 Country: United Kingdom Title: Working for a financial planning instituition Question: I hope this email finds you in the best of health and Imaan. I am considering working for an instituition in a middle eastern Muslim country, and the core activities of the business are financial planning - the main source of income for the business would be commission based on sales of insurance, pensions, investments and other such products. Would the income as an employee of such an instituition be regarded as lawful? The owner of the company is Muslim, furthermore the services they offer cover both western practices as well as Muslim. Jazak'Allah for your efforts to bring to to light the best of Islam. And may Allah swt grant you and your family the best of both worlds in return for your ongoing efforts to assist humanity - AMEEN! Answer ID: 32846 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 997/834/B=1432) We cannot have any Shariah rulings until we do not receive the detail of the work on western pattern. However, the work you would do through insurance shall be unlawful definitely. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
